assessments.subject: Capabilities and Meaning
assessments.result: Separate Apply/Adjoint/Controlled assumptions, exact basis trees, common pending MeaningEquality and finite closed-declaration checking match current code. Common Inverse/Controlled/Repeat/Then/Tensor/Conjugate clear attached Meaning; constructor spelling and Unitary annotations do not discharge it.

assessments.subject: Common judgment, finite materialization and selected projection
assessments.result: The chapter distinguishes source judgment from concrete eligibility and native acceptance. It retains checked_op/meaning-refined selected refusals and finite Specialize refusal; direct runtime-group transforms are linked as distinct from opaque packed endomorphisms.

assessments.subject: Eager evaluation, whole-body checking and recursion
assessments.result: Full call arity, ordered eager runtime evaluation and checking unused declarations/both arms/zero-fold bodies match inspected source rules. Checking is not described as execution. Checked Nat self-decrease, cycle refusals and bounded elaboration remain permitted, without an unrestricted recursion or quantitative-resource theorem claim.

assessments.subject: Owners, patterns and Q<Unit>
assessments.result: Nested tuples remain linear when they contain Q, including zero-width owners. Ordinary patterns, quantum split/join/coherent maps and Observe remain separate. Unit return transport does not erase work or exact scalar phase; linked finite/selected profile limitations remain explicit.

assessments.subject: Current and candidate features
assessments.result: General runtime closures, currying values, ADTs/coherent sums, traits, broader Op arrows/builders, Monad/do and host-I/O effects are not silently admitted. Scoped checked compiler bodies remain permitted and are not confused with reusable closures. Child feature completion is not claimed.

assessments.subject: Diagnostics, migration and evidence identity
assessments.result: Existing do/pure and bind_op migration refusals, real source error stages, stale evidence/source bindings and native gates are distinguished. The chapter does not promise a semantic test of grammar that rejects earlier or claim external qargo/qlippy consumer work.
